correctness.rationale: Reconstructed lexicographic conjugate-partition vertex filtration. Earlier neighbors are one-cell transfers indexed by edges D_iR_j of a bipartite Ferrers graph B_lambda (i<j plus diagonal if gap g_i≥2); their graph is its line graph, and the lower clique link has the graph B_lambda as nerve. Each noninitial link is connected and homotopy equivalent to a graph, so sequential cone attachments yield a simply connected CW model of dimension ≤2, hence a wedge of S². Counting vertices and edges in B_lambda gives 1−χ(link)=max(0,binom(s−2,2))+Σ_{i=2}^{s−1}[g_i≥2], with the s=1 initial case separately contributing 1 to χ. The product E(t,q)=∏_a(1+t q^a/(1−q^a)) and differentiation/marking an internal gap produce the stated positive generating series. Independent lower-link enumeration through n=10 covered 138 partitions and corroborated the local increments. The proof covers every n≥1; finite checks alone do not.
